results.title: Clean paper intake for abstract and executive summary generation
recommendedActions: Allow AI summarization with normal extraction provenance attached.

results.title: OCR-only scan with missing methods and dropped pages

findings.message: The source paper has pages that were not extracted.
findings.remediation: Block summarization until the paper is reprocessed and every page has extraction evidence.

findings.message: Required scientific sections are missing from the extracted text map.
findings.remediation: Re-run section segmentation or require manual section confirmation before summary generation.

findings.message: OCR confidence or glyph quality is too poor for a reliable AI-generated summary.
findings.remediation: Use a higher-quality text layer or route to manual intake review before summarization.

findings.message: One or more expected tables were not extracted for summarizer grounding.
findings.remediation: Hold key-finding and numeric-summary generation until table extraction is complete.

findings.message: Figure captions are missing from the summarizer intake packet.
findings.remediation: Regenerate figure-caption anchors or suppress figure-derived claims from the summary.

findings.message: Reference parsing coverage is too low for reliable related-work or implication summaries.
findings.remediation: Suppress citation-based implication bullets until reference parsing is repaired.

findings.message: Equation extraction coverage is below the configured summarizer threshold.
findings.remediation: Warn reviewers and avoid mathematical-method summaries until equation extraction is confirmed.

findings.message: The intake packet lacks required extraction provenance flags.
findings.remediation: Attach text, section, table, figure, reference, and digest evidence before releasing AI summaries.

findings.message: Overall source extraction completeness is below the AI summarizer safety threshold.
findings.remediation: Hold summarization and regenerate the intake packet from the source document.

findings.message: AI key-finding generation is enabled while source-ingestion quality findings are unresolved.
findings.remediation: Require clean intake status before generating key findings, implications, or next steps.

recommendedActions: Disable key-finding generation until intake quality is clean.
Attach the intake findings to the AI summarizer queue.
Regenerate extraction artifacts before key findings or implications are generated.
Show reviewers which source sections, tables, figures, or references are unsafe.
